title: Projects are easier to explore
summary:
The project directory got seven clearer paths, while streaming setup and the README logo got small repairs.

The project directory now groups apps into seven categories and opens on Vibe Coding. The README and PROJECTS.md also have categorized listings with clearer links to projects, demos, creators, and repositories.

The text API now waits for its ad eligibility check before setting up OpenAI-compatible response streams, including error responses.

A broken logo image was replaced, and the README now displays it at full available width.

highlights.title: Explore projects by category
highlights.text: Browse community projects across Vibe Coding, Creative, Games, Hack-&-Build, Chat, Social Bots, and Learn. The directory now opens on Vibe Coding. [Explore projects](https://pollinations.ai).
